title: Pure Maliss
summary:
Maliss cards only, with generic staples; the page's Firewall Dragon end board is left out. The Maliss monsters pay LP to summon themselves whenever they are banished, and the Maliss Traps can be activated the turn they are Set by banishing a Maliss monster you control, so every card feeds the next. The banlist shapes the list: Maliss White Binder is Forbidden, Dormouse and White Rabbit are Limited, and Maliss in Underground is Semi-Limited. The 2025 cards lead. Maliss

March Hare summons itself from the hand on either Main Phase by banishing another Maliss card and recovers a banished Maliss monster. Maliss in the Mirror negates a monster by banishing one of yours and, once banished, swaps a GY card for a fresh Maliss search.
main: Limited starter: banishes a Maliss monster from the Deck; summons itself when banished.
Limited: sets a Maliss Trap from the Deck; summons itself when banished.
Newest card: summons itself on either Main Phase; recovers a banished Maliss when banished.
Banishes a Maliss from the hand to draw 2; summons itself when banished.
Semi-Limited Field Spell: banishes a Maliss card; pumps the Links by 3000.
Newest Spell: negates a monster; banished, trades a GY card for a Maliss search.
Searches a Maliss monster and banishes a card on the field.
Summons a banished or GY Maliss and gains LP.
Summons a Maliss from the Deck, or a Maliss Link against three cards.
extra: Link-3: banishes a card on either turn by recycling a banished Maliss.
Link-3: searches a Maliss Spell; swaps their monsters' ATK and DEF.
Link-4: Quick Effect bounces monsters from field/GY up to co-linked monsters, and summons Cyberse from hand when a linked monster is sent to GY.
